title: "H08: Visual light sensitivity and personal exposure"
params:
  placement: glasses
  scenario: primary

## What this notebook checks

First determine which exposure metrics remain interpretable under the approved
missing-data and coverage rules. Define and check the Visual Light Sensitivity
Questionnaire-8 (VLSQ-8) score. Estimate the average association with visual
light sensitivity across sites separately from whether that association
differs by site. Report missing data, effect sizes in meaningful units, and the
groups of \(p\)-values adjusted together.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the prepared H08 dataset in `artifacts/06_model_data/H08.rds`.
- Produces: the VLSQ-8 score check, every planned test, fitted models, model
  checks, and adjusted results with 95% confidence intervals. Participant-day
  models report participants, participant-days (model observations), and
  sites; participant-level models report participants (model observations) and
  sites. The notebook also reports the number missing VLSQ-8 and the number
  missing each exposure outcome, with tables, figures, and exact source data.
- Data sensitivity: fit this identical H08 implementation to the
  manuscript-prepared dataset and compare exact samples, missingness,
  estimates, 95% confidence intervals, diagnostics, and conclusions.
- Formula display: the completed audit must contain a visible evaluated code
  cell printing the exact Wilkinson formulas passed to the selected model and
  every fitted comparison model.
